description: Kasteel Radboud at Medemblik is an incomplete water castle: an L-shaped brick wing, one round tower with a conical roof, and a low stump where another tower once stood, all inside a moat. The sky is overcast, about 13.4°C, with wind near 4.7 km/h. It is not a square of four equal towers. The museum is closed, and the view is the exterior from the public moat.
